metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Bert Radiator
records.biography_en: In Small Domestic Hauntings, Bert Radiator takes the role of radiator ghost. “It knocks because it has something to say.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small brass radiator bleed key and one miniature old radiator rib held against the side.

records.name: Nora Clothespin
records.biography_en: In Small Domestic Hauntings, Nora Clothespin takes the role of bedsheet ghost. “I was hung out to dry.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one short ivory bedsheet draped over a head lobe like a cap, two oversized clothespins on the hem, dark whole face and body visible.

records.name: Pip Nightlight
records.biography_en: In Small Domestic Hauntings, Pip Nightlight takes the role of night fright. “Could we leave this on?”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: tiny plug-shaped bedside nightlight with a warm clear amber lens.

records.name: Mina Cupboard
records.biography_en: In Small Domestic Hauntings, Mina Cupboard takes the role of cupboard poltergeist. “I put them back louder.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one small porcelain cup and two plain saucers balanced tightly in both hands.

records.name: Len Lostsock
records.biography_en: In Small Domestic Hauntings, Len Lostsock takes the role of laundry ghost. “The other one moved out.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: single striped sock worn as a floppy cap, a tiny laundry peg held at belly.

records.name: Otto Floorboard
records.biography_en: In Small Domestic Hauntings, Otto Floorboard takes the role of creaking-floor spirit. “Third board from the left. That's me.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one palm-sized warped plank with one round blunt nail head.
